name: Spc_MainLoop

name: Spc_StepSongOnly

name: Spc_StepSongFades

name: Spc_TrackLookAhead
notes: Sub-entry: tie/rest/note on 5A/5B 5C/60 5D/61; slide SUBW (SETC unused), |diff|*256/n by 3 DIVs, 24-bit negate after POP P, X reloaded. nit: steps 0 = raw diff, i.e. 256 passes in $07AF

name: Spc_NotePitch
notes: Scale misstated: t=(tuning lo+fine)&$FF gives P*(256+t)/256 if t<$80 else P*t/256; the high byte only adds (Q_hi*hi)/256 (<0.4%), not a second factor. State both

name: Spc_DrumNote
notes: Entry i at $F120+3i (36 B/song, $C7:1871), byte 2 <$80 x2 -> F281, byte 1 -> A5/A, byte 0 -> $1ACF (cmd $DC: F201/F380/F540, keeps X, no DSP); site $0542

name: Spc_RunSeqCommand
notes: SBC needs C=1: TrackStep's CMP #$C4 with BCC not taken gives it; push hi/lo + RET exact address; $1554/$15CC tables; first operand -> A/A5; site $050E

name: Spc_ReadSeqByte
notes: Sub-entry: [($02+X)] -> A/A5, 16-bit INC of the pointer, X/Y kept; all 17 handler sites + $0507 match the trace and lie in seq handlers ($1732..$1CFB)

name: Spc_PeekNote
notes: '(it reads at !Spc_Ptr93)' is false for $1B86 (2nd handler of $DC, $E4-$E7): it skips nothing, so $DC's operand is peeked as the next note (DC 21 1C -> $21). Document quirk

name: Spc_PeekNoteFrom
notes: Shared header: second handlers don't all read/advance Ptr93; $DC (1 operand) with $1B86 returns its operand byte as the note. Push sites $0786/$0789, $EB exits ok

name: Spc_TrackSlides
notes: P=1 delays $0111/$0131+X, vol/pan word adds with high-byte compare -> D0, 24-bit pitch step (ADDW + ADC), F360 count (0 = 256), pan LFO flip+reload; X kept, P=0; sites $03DD/$04B6

name: Spc_QueueCommand
notes: Callers note calls $03E0 unmatched code, but it is in Spc_StepTracks ($0377-$0414, now matched): write CALL from Spc_StepTracks ($03E0); keep $1308 as unmatched. Filter/full queue/echo ok

name: Spc_TrackEffects
notes: Song-only delay test, phase+step, offset = D x signed(h)/256 via MULs + SUBW, stage masks, JMP $0913, sites $0314/$033D/$0359/$0451. nit: h is (phase x 2)'s high byte, not phase hi x 2

name: Spc_TrackTremolo
notes: Track170 low byte + $0131 delay (all tracks), TempB7 = step high, phase hi change marks UnkD0, stage in bits 4-6 via XCN, falls into Spc_WriteVoice; JMP $0913 only site

name: Spc_WriteVoice
notes: Tremolo: MUL keeps ASL's carry, so phase>=$80 gives vol x (phase x 2-256)/256 (lowered), not unchanged; cap $7F only if sum>=$180 ($80-$17F kept as low byte). Fix volume line

name: Spc_WritePitch
notes: Pitch+vib offset; X<$10 by $AF (<$80: +p x adj x 2/256, >=$80: p x adj/256), X>=$1C by $B1 (0 skips), 8-13 raw; PL/PH via Temp9C, X kept; CALL $0C41

name: Spc_LfoRate
notes: Every call negates the step; stage>0 counts down and adds rate/4 on turns to + (<$80), to - ($80-$BF) or all ($C0+): '0 starts a turn' is wrong. Entry omits TempB7 (bit 7 read, $C0 shape)

name: Spc_AnimateBuiltin
notes: Simulated: D8 3..$23, DIV skips header byte 9, even=$70/odd=$07, $23 also flips byte 1 hi; X=9 or kept, A=new D8. nit: skipped while 87.4 pauses; byte 1 = its high nibble

name: Spc_StartSong
notes: Steps 1-6 traced (set copy/subw move/NoTrack, resume loop, $1352/$1316/$1397/$12F9), DSP line, Arg1/Arg2 vs Audio_StartSong, $0BDE BRA and Song11 fall-in, Exit SP=$FF
